runner_limit: own_sites accepts any panic in the exact named owner; acceptance must additionally require these exact assertion ranges and intended values, reviewed in complete logs.

assertion.text: assert_ne!(left, right, "each marker and its exact value participate in identity");

omit-scalar-text-pin.required_failure: The marker equality must fail for DataFusion text protected=false: left None, right Some("true").
omit-scalar-text-pin.not_accepted: compile failure, setup or fixture panic, source refusal, timeout, abort, skip or exemption, different assertion, or incomplete whole-binary inventory

overbroad-scalar-text-pin.required_failure: The marker equality must fail for Oracle CLOB protected=false: left Some("true"), right None. The positive declarations preceding it must complete.
overbroad-scalar-text-pin.not_accepted: compile failure, setup or fixture panic, source refusal, timeout, abort, skip or exemption, different assertion, or incomplete whole-binary inventory

omit-scalar-text-digest.required_failure: The exact each-marker identity assert_ne must fail with equal digests for plain versus scalar-text=true; no type is changed.
omit-scalar-text-digest.not_accepted: compile failure, setup or fixture panic, source refusal, timeout, abort, skip or exemption, different assertion, or incomplete whole-binary inventory

remove-scalar-text-admission.required_failure: The native raw-search delivery equality must fail with left 0 and right 1 for oracle upper=false after exact typed baseline/opt-in answer and independent expected-row equalities passed. Do not credit a setup/refusal failure or claim an UPPER-specific mutant kill.
remove-scalar-text-admission.not_accepted: compile failure, setup or fixture panic, source refusal, timeout, abort, skip or exemption, different assertion, or incomplete whole-binary inventory

required_head_restored: Complete affected binary passes, identical discovered inventory and unchanged owning function hashes; native head/restored must show the actual million-row Oracle census and both plain/UPPER ordinary-text-siblings queries.
restore: Unchanged runner finally restores exact tracked bytes, confirms raw index identity, reruns the whole affected binary, and retains source/index manifests. Final export raw index equality is reported and must be reviewed too.
